input_scope: Clean HEAD snapshot plus four scoped trainer files; unrelated dirty probes excluded. Prior evidence bindings retained.

worker.verification: Primary independently verified input hashes, exact identities/holdout, partition rows and per-scope pair arithmetic against original raw bytes and C# coverage. Worker scripts not integrated.

pipeline.checks: Independent raw-byte and per-game metadata comparison, exact saved split/metric/coverage binding, saved-only/file-bound Verify, merge overwrite refusal.

limitations: Pipeline diagnostic only: four ordered matchups and 24 held-out games; correlated observations are not independent samples or a playing-strength estimate.
Existing trainer console success heuristics (encoding validity from >55%) are not adopted as conclusions; only exact pipeline consistency is accepted.
Raw datasets, simulator binaries and model remain local SHA-256-bound evidence; no relaxation or rewriting of original admission fingerprints.
Manifest hash proves which file was used, not when it was chosen; chronological predeclaration is separately bound by the original published pilot plan.
No PvP rule or card certification is added. No overall completion percentage is inferred.
